text.p: Hyatt Hotels Wednesday unveiled some competition for the Poconos: A hotel in Acapulco with an on-premises synagogue and a full Kosher restaurant.
The 645-room Hyatt Regency Acapulco has been rennovated as a result of "a steady increase in Jewish visitors" to the Pacific Coast Mexican resort, Hyatt International Corp. said.
Services at the hotel's synagogue will be handled by a Jewish community in Mexico City, the announcement from the privately held Chicago-based hotel chain said.
The hotel's full-service Kosher restaurant features a special selection of dishes for Shabbat on Friday evenings, it added.
